text:
- Use left arm only: locate microwave, `articulate` left `open` 90, then `home` left. Avoid right arm/carrying.
- After home, verify from images that the door is visibly open and the microwave is still visible. A wide-open door often has y-size ~25+, but images decide.
- Do not retry `open` just to reach 25+ if the door already looks open; repeated opening can over-swing and make the microwave `NOT_SEEN`, causing failure.
- If y-size is still closed (~7-10) or door looks closed, retry once after home/locate. If `SHORT`/`NOT_SEEN`, home, locate, reassess; never call done while not visible.
- Call `done` with empty checks only after visual confirmation; no `on_table`/`upright` checks.
goal: Left arm has opened the microwave door wide open, left arm is home, and the microwave remains visible; no object held.
